verdict.description: BLOCK iff at least one CRITICAL finding exists

judge_model.description: Resolved model that produced this review (provider/model-id or class name)

isolation_mode.description: What actually served the review. 'rest-gateway:<url>' = fresh-context cross-model call to that OpenAI-compatible endpoint; 'harness-native' = fresh-context subagent fallback (weaker guarantee). Was previously the fixed literal 'liter-llm' regardless of endpoint, which made a same-family self-grade indistinguishable from a real cross-model review.

producer_model.description: The model whose work was reviewed, for the judge!=producer comparison. 'unknown' means the check could not be enforced.

cross_model_check.description: Whether the judge was proven different from the producer. 'unverified-producer-unknown' means the packet carried no producer_model, so the comparison passed trivially — not a clean review.

checked_classes.description: REQUIRED (non-empty) when findings is empty: the failure classes the judge checked and why each does not apply. A zero-finding report without this is rejected as theater.

file.description: Repo-relative path or artifact filename the finding anchors to

evidence.description: The hunk/criterion/quote/contradiction that proves the claim

allOf.$comment: change-idt-001: a decision artifact is only meaningful if a DIFFERENT model judged it. same-model-collision and unverified-producer-unknown are honest records for other modes, but for a decision they mean the cross-model guarantee was not obtained — so the artifact must not validate.
